reviews.title: Great headset!
reviews.comment: I recently purchased the EPOS Impact 1061T ANC Premium Open Office Headset, and I can confidently say it’s a five-star product that has transformed my workday. As someone who spends hours on calls in a busy environment, this headset delivers everything I could ask for and more.The sound quality is exceptional—crisp, clear, and natural, thanks to the Super Wideband audio. Whether I’m on a Microsoft Teams meeting or a client call, my voice comes through flawlessly, and the hybrid adaptive ANC does an incredible job of blocking out background noise. I’ve tested it in chaotic settings—think bustling coffee shops and open-plan offices—and it’s like magic how it isolates my voice while keeping distractions at bay. Colleagues have even commented on how professional and clear I sound, no matter where I am.Comfort is another standout feature. The lightweight design, soft cushions, and padded headband make it a joy to wear for long periods. I often forget I’m even wearing it during marathon meeting days. The wireless charging stand is a game-changer too—pop it on the stand, and it’s ready to go when I need it, no fumbling with cables.The smart features, like the intuitive controls and the ability to connect to multiple devices via Bluetooth, make it incredibly user-friendly. The microphone boom’s flexibility—swiveling to either side—is a thoughtful touch that adds to its versatility.Overall, the EPOS Impact 1061T ANC is a premium headset that’s worth every penny. It’s perfect for professionals who need top-tier audio, comfort, and noise cancellation in a sleek, reliable package. Five stars without hesitation!
reviews.author: Rich B

reviews.title: Excellent Headset - Recommend Sidetone Setting of 0% If Hearing Yourself Is Distracting
reviews.comment: EPOS Impact 1061T ANC:  I was going to return these initially because out of the box these headphones were feeding me back my own voice in an unbelievably distracting way.  My own sibilance was particularly annoying, delayed and distorted.  This is how I fixed it: 1)  Download the EPOS app. 2)  Pair the headphones. 3)  Set Sidetone to 0% for both TalkThrough and ANC.  This is critical.  Without this, I would have returned the headphones because even 5% was too distracting.  Turn off Sidetone completely by setting it to 0%.  This is a setting for both ANC and TalkThrough.  Toggle between both and make sure they're both at 0. If you want to hear your own voice, select TalkThrough.  This has the most natural feeling.  If you don't want to hear things around you, reduce the TalkThrough level from high to medium to low to see what works best.  If it's still too much background noise, turn on ANC.  While your own voice is muffled, the resonance in your own head will make up for it.  This is what I typically keep it on.  It actually helps me focus more on the person speaking this way. Hopefully this helps anyone having this issue.  I called a few friends using these and mentioned I had a new headset, they said I sound clearer than if I were just using the phone.  I walked out near a busy street and they couldn't hear any outside noise.  I even put my head right near a speaker playing a voice only podcast very loud just to find out if it cancels out the sound for the recipient.  They couldn't hear a thing besides me.  Very impressive technology.  5 stars. Side note, I got these "Open Box - Like New".  The look and function as new.  Saved a bunch going this way.
